description: The CodeBoarding-action system follows a sequential pipeline pattern that orchestrates codebase analysis, generates structural visualizations, enhances reports with interactive UX elements, and captures telemetry data to provide actionable architectural insights directly within GitHub PRs.

components.name: Analysis Orchestrator
components.description: Acts as the central controller for the GitHub Action lifecycle. It manages environment validation, determines the analysis scope (incremental vs. full), and coordinates the execution of the underlying analysis engine.

components.name: Workflow Execution Controller
components.description: Acts as the primary entry point and state machine for the GitHub Action, orchestrating lifecycle phases, managing authentication, and enforcing quota limits.

components.name: Analysis Strategy & Metadata Resolver
components.description: Determines the technical scope of the analysis by resolving commit depths and deciding between incremental or full analysis modes.

components.name: Quality & Health Monitor
components.description: Processes raw analysis output to generate actionable governance metrics and health reports.

components.name: Structural Visualization Engine
components.description: Processes the raw structural data of the codebase to identify architectural diffs. It transforms these changes into Mermaid.js syntax to provide a visual representation of how the PR affects the system's design.

components.name: Structural Diff Analyzer
components.description: The core analytical engine that compares the current state of the codebase against the baseline to identify structural changes at the file and method level.

components.name: Mermaid DSL Transformer
components.description: Responsible for the transformation phase, taking structured diff data and applying visual logic to generate Mermaid.js syntax.

components.name: Architectural Mapper & Formatter
components.description: Provides the foundational mapping between the physical file system and the logical architectural model, handling component identification and metadata formatting.

components.name: Integration & UX Generator
components.description: Enhances the analysis report with actionable metadata. It detects developer environments to generate deep links for IDEs and webviews, ensuring the analysis is accessible and interactive for reviewers.

components.name: Environment Context Resolver
components.description: Probes the execution and configuration environment to identify supported IDEs and editor preferences for deep-link protocol selection.

components.name: Actionable Link Generator
components.description: Translates internal file references and line numbers into external URI schemes for various IDEs and web-based visualizations.

components.name: CTA Markdown Orchestrator
components.description: Coordinates the environment detection and link generation processes to assemble the final formatted Markdown/HTML block for report injection.

components.name: Telemetry & Feedback Handler
components.description: Captures execution metrics and user feedback. It standardizes the payload with environment-specific keys (OIDC/GitHub context) and transmits it to the CodeBoarding backend for quality monitoring.

components.name: Feedback Workflow Orchestrator
components.description: Acts as the entry point and controller for the telemetry lifecycle, managing the execution flow, parsing CLI arguments, and sequencing data gathering and transmission.

components.name: Contextual Metadata Factory
components.description: Extracts environment variables, GitHub context, and OIDC tokens to construct a standardized, enriched JSON payload for telemetry.

components.name: API Transmission Gateway
components.description: Encapsulates network I/O logic, managing secure communication, HTTP headers, authentication, and endpoint resolution for the CodeBoarding API.
